jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Gwarimpa, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant.
Responsibilities: Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations. Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time. Prepare monthly financial reports for management.
Requirements: B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified) 4 Years' Experience in Accounting Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Professional development support. Performance bonus. Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Tech Sales Closer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Tech Sales Closer for our sales team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria, with a base pay of ₦100,000 per month plus uncapped commission on closed deals.
Responsibilities: Close warm leads by taking qualified prospects from first call through to a signed deal. Keep a clear pipeline: record every lead, follow up on proposals and report on deals closed. Work to a monthly sales target.
Requirements: 2 Years' Experience in Sales Proven record of closing deals CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Remote working arrangement. Uncapped commission on every deal you close. Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Chef
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Chef for a hotel and apartments company in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.
Responsibilities: Prepare and cook meals to a consistent standard of quality for hotel and apartment guests. Plan menus and portions, and suggest new dishes. Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards. Monitor stock, order ingredients and keep waste low.
Requirements: 3 Years' Experience as a Chef Hotel, apartment or restaurant kitchen background Able to cook Nigerian and continental dishes CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Opportunity to grow with a hospitality company and receive training. Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Sales Assistant
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Sales Assistant for a clothing store in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for a presentable, confident communicator who is comfortable handling fabrics and can resume immediately.
Responsibilities: Welcome customers, understand what they are looking for and help them choose the right clothing and fabrics. Handle, fold and display fabrics and clothing with care, and keep the shop floor tidy. Keep the store presentable and report stock and customer requests to the store management.
Requirements: 1-2 Years' Experience in Sales or Retail Good communication skills Presentable and comfortable handling fabrics Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Other statutory benefits.
